title: console: the Packages list shows an empty Actions column on every row, and the package sheet breaks words mid-word
body:
Filing gate **③ a task the maintainer set**: objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2188, the maintainer's browser pass of 2026-10-20. Each defect gets its own card, by the maintainer's ruling 「按照按照具体的issue单独提交卡片，不受数量限制。」 (recorded on objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2188, `6283467378`). This is finding **F-26** of track 2 (Setup as the system administrator), by the cloud tester `session_01VuXyJvhGKJy8qeUvhKyxzv`. It was measured on HotCRM `main` `f22dfa52` with `@objectstack/*` 18.0.0-next.5, in Chromium at 1440×900 on a locally booted, seeded install. The evidence is on the branch `claude/qa-setup-pass-2026-10-20` at `ed4f40e42`, which is never merged. Filed by the `repo:hotcrm` seat 2 (`os-support-ai`, session `session_01KqkTQNLcxVc588eZpJmp1r`). ⛔ Not a claim. Grade: triage's.

**Reader (who acts):** objectui triage routes it. Paths under `src/` are HotCRM's (objectstack-ai/hotcrm).

## The finding, as measured

- **Actual:** the *Actions* header sits over an empty cell in every row (2 app rows, 23 platform rows); actions live only in the row's sheet. In the sheet, the Description breaks inside words ("marketplac / e", "Con / tracts").
- **Evidence:** `sweep-[`02-packages.png`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/ed4f40e42b8b6ce059a4e648f25f8f6037ffd9f6/qa/2026-10-20-setup-pass/shots/02-packages.png), [`02-apps-packages-hotcrm-detail.png`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/ed4f40e42b8b6ce059a4e648f25f8f6037ffd9f6/qa/2026-10-20-setup-pass/shots/02-apps-packages-hotcrm-detail.png).
- **class: a** (UX defect). **Reach:** every admin.
- **Suspected landing:** objectstack `console` packages component.
- **Dedupe words:** packages actions column empty, word-break description.

## Seat review

- **Landing (seat review):** objectui `PackagesPage`.

## Dedupe

Method: semantic `search_issues` on objectstack-ai/objectstack and objectstack-ai/objectui, open and closed, using the finding's own dedupe words and a second phrasing; plus a grep of every issue title (objectstack #1–#24751, objectui #7–#13153) listed through the repo-scoped `issues?state=all` endpoint, because the semantic search can miss title words (objectstack#14743).
- 0 hits in objectui, 0 in objectstack. **New.**
